brief: The canvas displays a large, constantly shifting lattice of interconnected, glowing cells. This field of life is dynamic, with cells continually being born, decaying, and dissipating. When a cell expires, it flares brightly before dissolving into a fading trail of residual light. The entire simulation is set against a dark background that pulses rhythmically, emphasizing the life cycle within the pattern. The visualization evolves autonomously, requiring no user input.

The simulation creates a mesmerizing field of interconnected particles where new cells emerge with soft glows, linking to nearby neighbors through thin connecting lines. As cells mature and begin to decay, they flare brightly before dissolving into fading trails of light. The entire scene pulses rhythmically against a dark background, emphasizing the organic life cycle within the pattern. The visualization evolves autonomously without any user input, creating an immersive, ever-changing display that feels both mechanical and alive.
